$Comment: What Santa's Stocking holds: the free offer on Santa's stall, once a day
(ShopEntries/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Offer_Stocking.json). Every roll is read on its own: the first
always pays a few Christmas Coins through the Currency reward kind, and the second is a chance at a
Christmas Present on top (Chance is a percent from 0 to 100). Pool is one draw from the bag below,
weighted against each other: candy canes most days, a Gingerbread Cookie the rest. Every item goes
where the player's pickup settings send it, with the game's own pickup notice.
Text names this table on the stall and in the notice that pays it, and gives its hover a line; the
hover then lists what it pays. A companion mod adds its own rolls with a file of its own that names
Name: Christmas_Stocking
